event_detail: Drawer: the empty gripper stays at the left corner in front of a lower cabinet panel, under the counter edge, in nearly the same pose for 4.8 s, without grasping a drawer handle.
evidence: Shoulder views show the arm almost unchanged across all four frames, gripper at the left end of the counter near the tall cabinet; the drawers under the counter look closed with their handles in place. The wrist camera sees only a gray raised cabinet panel, the counter underside and a bit of wooden floor, with no drawer interior and no straw; nothing is in the gripper. It is possible this is the robot's slow approach to a handle, so confidence is moderate.
